rationale: Current joined pyc set is not source-free derivable because canonical LiTS contains data-dependent imports.
Synthetic precompile/compileall cannot prove equal cache set or equal import-cost behavior and can advantage split WVS.
Redirecting cache reads to a fresh empty prefix and disabling writes removes pyc prestate from candidate measurement instead of attempting to clone it.
The protected process envelope already inherits parent environment into the main cell child, and S15 descendants inherit the cell environment.
Current joined and split measured launchers do not set this law, therefore no current PASS is lawful.
adoption_boundary: HQ/T5-repair fan-in or a separate protected joined-runner successor must adopt the cache-neutral environment on BOTH paths and perform exact CPython 3.11.3 qualification before split WVS measurement is eligible.
